howItWorksFullSection.heading: A modern process for designing your dream space.
howItWorksFullSection.description: From the first style quiz to the final design delivery, we make every step feel effortless and inspiring.

steps.heading: Match with one of our talented designers and get inspired.
steps.description: Take a style quiz to help us get to know you a little bit better, then choose your interior designer from our personalized recommendations. With over 10 years of experience and nearly 1 million designs, our expert team will help you turn your vision into reality.

steps.heading: Partner with your designer to create a home you love.
steps.description: Great design doesn’t happen alone. Let your designer guide you to solutions that meet your functional needs and products that suit your unique style. See it come to life with a 3D rendering of the design in your actual space.

steps.heading: Shop exclusive deals, and bring your design home with ease.
steps.description: Access the best prices on your favorite home brands, get exclusive discounts, and shop everything you need for your space in a single, streamlined checkout. The result? Even better than your dreams.
